description: One device, as this conversation sees it. Not the state of the hardware and not the state reported upward — those are the device's twin and its reachability state, which live in the device-status resource.

unknown-to-the-mapper.description: The mapper holds nothing for this device. A device resource may well exist in Kubernetes and be in this state on the node that is supposed to drive it.

CREATE_DEVICE_MODEL.description: The class arrives first. The device itself is still unknown, so the machine does not move.

REGISTER_DEVICE.guard: the mapper already holds the device's model

driven.description: The mapper holds the device, has opened the southbound link, and is collecting on the configured cycle.

UPDATE_DEVICE.description: The whole device again. The link is reopened only when the connection details moved.

GET_DEVICE.description: A read of the mapper's own view. Nothing about the device changes.

retired.description: The mapper has dropped the device and disconnected. Nothing in the interface distinguishes this from a device that was never registered, which is why the initial state is named for the mapper's ignorance rather than for the device's absence.
